name: CALVIN
description: Language-conditioned manipulation benchmark with ~24 hours of teleoperated play data across 4 tabletop environments (A-D). 34 unique tasks with ~24,000 language-annotated trajectories. Standard benchmark for language-conditioned multi-task policies.
source: University of Freiburg (Mees, Hermann, Burgard), RAL 2022

name: RLBench (18-task subset)
description: Large-scale simulated manipulation benchmark with 100 tasks in CoppeliaSim. Standard 18-task subset used for PerAct and RVT-2 evaluation. Scripted oracle demos via motion planners. 100 demos/task for training.

name: LIBERO
description: Lifelong learning benchmark with 130 language-conditioned manipulation tasks organized into 4 suites (Spatial, Object, Goal, 100). 50 human-teleoperated demos per task. Studies knowledge transfer under controlled distribution shifts.
source: UT Austin / Sony AI (Liu et al.), NeurIPS 2023

name: Language-Table
description: 442K real-robot episodes of language-conditioned block pushing and rearrangement on a tabletop. One of the largest real-robot manipulation datasets. 93.5% success on 87,000 unique language strings.

name: BC-Z Dataset
description: 25,877 teleoperated demonstrations across 100 manipulation tasks (125 hours). Collected via VR teleoperation on 12 Google Everyday Robots. Supports zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks via language conditioning.
source: Google Brain / Robotics at Google (Jang et al.), CoRL 2021

name: UMI Cup in the Wild
description: 1,447 cup-and-saucer arrangement demonstrations collected across 30 real-world locations using handheld GoPro grippers with SLAM tracking. Robot-agnostic data deployable on UR5e and Franka without retraining.

name: RoboTurk
description: Crowdsourced teleoperation dataset with 2,144 real-robot demos from 54 users across 3 long-horizon tasks (111 hours), plus 2,217 simulation demos. Pioneered scalable crowdsourced robot data collection via smartphone teleoperation.

name: ManiSkill2
description: GPU-parallelized manipulation benchmark with 20 task families, 2,000+ object models, and 4M+ demo frames in SAPIEN. Covers rigid and soft-body, single and dual-arm, stationary and mobile manipulation.
source: UC San Diego / Hillbot (Gu et al.), ICLR 2023

name: RoboCasa
description: Large-scale household simulation with 100 kitchen tasks across 2,500 environments and 150+ object categories. 100K+ training trajectories from 1,250 human demos + MimicGen synthesis. Designed for generalist household robot policies.
source: UT Austin / NVIDIA (Nasiriany et al.), RSS 2024

name: Ravens Benchmark
description: 10 simulated tabletop rearrangement tasks in PyBullet with scripted oracle demos. Transporter Networks achieve 90%+ from just 100 demos. Sample-efficiency experiments from 1 to 1000 demos per task.
